name: Uno Minda Limited

profile.summary: Uno Minda Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies auto components and systems in India and internationally. It provides alloy wheels, automotive switches, horns, infotainment systems, speakers, socket assemblies, fuel hoses, sensors, actuators, controllers, telematics and connected solutions, alternate fuel systems, air filtration systems, canisters, seat head rest and arm rests, luggage boards, automotive wireless chargers, seat recliner mechanism, multi-mode drive switches, USB chargers, wheel covers, seat belts, shifters, cameras, air ducts and washer bottles, EA pads, spoilers, steering wheels with air bags, body sealings, fuel caps, and brake hoses.
